caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic measuring cup with a handle, rendered in shades of gray and black on a plain, off-white background. The cup is conical in shape, widening towards the top and set on a round, flat base. The handle is attached at the upper half of the cup and curves outward. The surface of the cup shows signs of wear and patina, indicating some age or use. On the exterior of the cup, there are engraved horizontal lines with labels marking units of measurement, including “1 QUART,” “1 PINT,” “1/2 PINT,” and “1 GILL.” There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing, and the composition focuses solely on the cup, centrally placed within the frame.
title: Pa. German Graduated Measure
